scope: Known-truth mathematical fixtures only. No physical measurement claim.

active_study.truth: two-variable Bernoulli SCM: P(X=1)=0.5; P(Y=1|do(X=0))=0.1, P(Y=1|do(X=1))=0.9
active_study.primary_endpoint: absolute finite-model posterior-mean effect error at equal budget
active_study.success_rule: Report measured paired outcomes and exact counts, including negative or tied comparisons; no universal superiority claim.
active_study.cost_control: All actions cost 1; cost_eig must match eig exactly in this control.

replay.stopped_then_resumed: action/outcome/weight event bytes must equal uninterrupted run

faults.pair_commit: kill before/after each intercepted rename; after recovery both outputs must be old or new, never mixed
faults.snapshot: concurrent atomic source replacement must bind returned parsed values to exact returned hash
faults.aliases: dangling symlink to other output must reject without source changes

conformal.method: split conformal absolute-residual order statistic ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))
conformal.calibration: independent from fitting and selection; guaranteed scope requires exchangeability
conformal.insufficient_rank: explicit unavailable rather than finite fabricated interval
